title: 11.1 Circumference and Arc Length

icans: I can find the circumference of a circle and use it to solve problems.
I can find the length of an arc and use arc lengths to find measures.
I can convert between degree and radian measure.

vocab: a portion of the ________________ of a circle
the __________ of a central angle whose arc is the same length as the radius

blocks.p: Wrap a string around each object to measure its circumference. Measure its diameter. Divide.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

blocks.stem:
a.  Find the circumference of a circle with a diameter of 9 centimeters.
b.  A circle has a circumference of 38 feet. Find its radius.
A bike tire has a diameter of 26 inches. About how many revolutions does it make to travel 1000 feet?

notes: Arc length: arc length of AB = (m(arc AB) ÷ 360°) · _______________

blocks.stem: Find the length of arc AB. Round to the nearest hundredth.
The length of arc AB is 11 meters and the radius is 7 meters. Find m(arc AB). Round to the nearest tenth.

notes: Radians: 180° = _______________ radians. To change degrees to radians, multiply by π/180; to change radians to degrees, multiply by 180/π.

blocks.stem:
a.  Convert 45° to radians.
b.  Convert 5π/6 radians to degrees.
A circle has a radius of 12 inches. Find the length of a 150° arc. Round to the nearest hundredth.

a.  Convert 3π/4 radians to degrees.
b.  Convert 120° to radians.

tickets.stem: Find the circumference of a circle with a diameter of 14 inches. Round to the nearest hundredth.
A circle has a radius of 10 feet. Find the length of a 72° arc. Round to the nearest hundredth.
